concept.title: Yaad Rakhna - Worn Colour Combos
concept.voiceoverScript: Yaad rakhna. Mocha brown aur cream achhe lagte hain, pur powder blue daalo, toh look ekdum romantic ho jaata hai. Moss green aur beige theek hai, pur merlot daalo, toh look elevated. Wine aur grey sundar hain, blush pink milao, toh poora feminine. Pale yellow aur light denim cute hai, pur cherry red daalo, toh seedha next level. Aise aur combos chahiye toh follow kar lo.

scenes.visualPrompt: Bright minimal studio with a plain warm-white backdrop and light oak floor, soft even diffused daylight, late morning, static locked-off medium-wide full-length shot at chest height. She wears a mocha brown fine-knit top and cream wide-leg trousers, with a powder blue cardigan already draped loosely over her shoulders from the first frame, its sleeves hanging softly down the front. The low wooden stool sits beside her. She stands still, looks straight into the camera and speaks warmly, then lightly rests one hand on the front edge of the cardigan and gives a small relaxed smile. The cardigan stays resting on her shoulders the whole time. Calm, friendly, polished mood.
scenes.dialogue: Yaad rakhna. Mocha brown aur cream achhe lagte hain, pur powder blue daalo, toh look ekdum romantic ho jaata hai.

scenes.visualPrompt: Bright minimal studio with a plain warm-white backdrop and light oak floor, soft even diffused daylight, late morning, static locked-off medium-wide full-length shot at chest height. The low wooden stool sits beside her. First half: she wears a moss green relaxed knit top and beige wide-leg trousers, and a merlot leather shoulder bag rests on the stool. She looks straight into the camera and speaks warmly, then picks up the merlot leather shoulder bag in one smooth motion, slings it onto her shoulder and rests one hand on the strap, giving a small pleased nod. Midway there is one clean hard cut to the identical framing, same studio, same light, same stool: she now wears a wine-coloured blouse and a grey pleated skirt, with a blush pink cardigan resting on the stool. Speaking warmly to camera, she lifts the blush pink cardigan and drapes it loosely over her shoulders, its sleeves hanging softly down the front, then rests one hand on its front edge and gives a small relaxed smile. Each outfit is fully worn on her body, not held up. Warm, easy mood.
scenes.dialogue: Moss green aur beige theek hai, pur merlot daalo, toh look elevated. Wine aur grey sundar hain, blush pink milao, toh poora feminine.

so the dialogue didn't complete in the shot generated and drape cut through her shoulders and google flow gave the following feedback


AI video models can run into a couple of limitations when handling complex actions and spoken dialogue:

Dialogue Length: The default clip duration may not have provided enough time for her to finish speaking the complete line at a natural pace.
Complex Physics & Clipping: Combining multiple physical actions at once—picking up a cardigan, draping it over her shoulders, turning, and speaking—often causes visual artifacts like clothing clipping through the body.
Here are a few ways we can fix this:

Increase clip duration: We can set the duration to 15 seconds to give her enough time to deliver the full line.
Simplify the action: Describe her starting with the cardigan already draped over her shoulders or resting beside her without the complex pick-up motion.
Break into separate shots: Split the talking shot and the cardigan styling into two shorter clips.
